declaration: Frozen after source own_policy results and content timing diagnostics, before this recurrent training or its free evaluations. No selection by new training outcomes.

data.rule: One common frozen own_policy autonomous public stream per seed; teachers supply labels only. Full8-lane data retained for separate evaluation warmup; training reads lanes0..3 only.
data.matching: Identical requests, targets, eight-class counts and quantity at every update. end_only supervises every fixed anchor at END; wait_mixed moves exactly half to the same-request processing-WAIT candidate within the same update. Original WAIT target remains WAIT.

train.state: Start actual147456 inherited h on fit lanes; continuously carry complete h through every update. Detach graph only at128-tick optimizer boundaries; no hidden reset or request boundary warmup.
train.parameters: Original support of undirected edge_shared plus existing conditional FINISH coef/bias for two jobs; preserve exact support and project inactive coordinates0 after every step. Fixed input/output ports, BEGIN affine coefficients, all normalization means/std and graph topology remain frozen.
train.action_loss: All tick/job positions. Weighted OTHER/BEGIN1/BEGIN2 CE plus weighted WAIT/eightFINISH conditional9 CE at teacher nonBEGIN rows; both numerators divide by original all-position weights.sum. WAIT0 weight0.1; all others1. Every teacher FINISH retains its specific eight-class target in both arms.
train.extra_loss: Additional conditional8 CE on selected eightFINISH offsets only, reduction mean, weight1. Same labels/counts/denominator per update; only temporal positions differ. No WAIT action is relabeled FINISH.

optimizer.name: Adam
optimizer.initialization: Fresh identical zero-state Adam in both arms; source backbone Adam from its original147456 training is retained as provenance, not resumed.

train.initialization: Same exact own_policy controller, source support and source h in both arms; conditional FINISH buffers promoted to trainable parameters without numerical change.

inference: Unmodified inherited FinishController.step: group-first BEGIN choice from two fixed affine offsets; independent conditional WAIT/eightFINISH choice from0 and eight learned offsets. Exact tie repair runs only at inference, never in gradient path. No private state gates or teacher inputs.
persistence: Per-arm source binding, initial state, final all-state checkpoint and model, each update losses/budget/data/hidden/model hashes. Seed0 first auxiliary-moved update saves complete before/after model, Adam and h for independent reconstruction.
evaluation: Separate prospective evaluation by wait_eval; primary actual long task completion and idle action frequency. Learned states during fixed-data replay are not mistaken for an on-policy deployment world.
limits: Externally labeled fixed autonomous experience, not new self-generated experience during recurrent optimization.
BEGIN decoder coefficients are fixed but trained recurrent weights may change its inputs and decisions.
Actors4..7 are held out only from this fit; original backbone birth training saw all8 actors.
